name: Bloodlines
source:
The Bloodline has been going back for generations. It might seem like just a little fraternity, like sexy girls and awesome guys and lots of alcohol. And sure, it's a little bit of that. But more than that, the Bloodline is brotherhood. It is the unbreakable bond two brothers have with each other. And brotherhood is forever.

Buchanan University freshman Sanghoon is looking for his distant older brother HJ at a Bloodlines party. More than that, the lonely dog is looking for anyone to see him at all. His sweet but fraternal snow leopard friend Andre gives him the feeling of brotherhood he's always been looking for, as does the strange but alluring affection from HJ's borzoi friend Marty. When Marty takes a dangerous interest in Sanghoon, the border collie finds himself in deeper than he ever expected.

[From [url=https://wannabeyourdog2.itch.io/bloodlines]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
血统可以追溯到几代人之前。这可能看起来只是一个小兄弟会，比如性感的女孩和很棒的男人以及大量的酒精。当然，这只是一点点。但更重要的是，血脉是兄弟情谊。这是两兄弟之间牢不可破的纽带。而兄弟情谊是永远的。

布坎南大学新生桑洪正在血统派对上寻找他的远房哥哥HJ。更重要的是，这只孤独的狗正在寻找任何人能看到他。他可爱但兄弟般的雪豹朋友安德烈（Andre）给了他一直在寻找的兄弟情谊，HJ的猎狼朋友马蒂（Marty）也给了他奇怪但诱人的感情。当马蒂对桑霍产生危险的兴趣时，这只边境牧羊犬发现自己陷入了比他预想的更深的境地。
